prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 50.7 °C (64% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 55.7 °C (55% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.2 °C (47% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.84 s (within 1% of healthy). Valve switching latency remains tightly within normal healthy tolerances.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.58 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 361 W·min/l (6% below healthy). Pump delivers nominal flow rate at baseline electrical input power.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.6 bar (2% below healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.

Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.85 s (within 1% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.

Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.5 bar (2% below healthy). Elevated pressure ripple across working lines indicates moderate degradation of accumulator pre-charge.
